title: Behaviour contract
description: What the usage data should look like if one requirement is being met. Produced by the interview engine, checked by the drift detector, shown on the evidence board.

company_id.description: Company whose interviews produced this contract. Missing means the built-in demo company (medicare_billing_demo).

statement.description: What the system must do, in user terms (8090 Feature Requirements style).

feature.description: Feature Requirements doc this belongs to, e.g. 'Claim submission'.

role.description: snake_case role. Demo company: billing_clerk, medical_coder, denial_specialist or practice_manager; other companies: a slug of the interviewee's position. Drift is always measured per role, never per person.

signal.description: The contract shape. Each maps to one query template in the drift detector.

description.description: Which tasks count, in plain words.

filter.description: Machine filter over event props, e.g. {"requires_prior_auth": true}.

min_tasks.description: A window with fewer tasks is skipped.

min_people.description: Privacy floor: never report a group smaller than this.

learning_period_weeks.description: Weeks after launch where only improvement is checked.

source.description: legacy_logs is strong evidence; interview-only lowers confidence.

values.description: metric_id -> value observed in the legacy system.

events_required.description: Event names the modernized app must emit: from the catalog in medicare_contracts.json for the demo company, proposed snake_case names for other companies.

related_detectors.description: Layer 2 discovery detectors whose signals help explain drift, e.g. 'notes_pattern:auth_number'.

code.description: Legacy code enforces or supports it.

per.description: What one unit is, e.g. 'claim at risk of denial'.

demo_value.description: true = planted number for the demo, say so on stage.

hypotheses.description: Only for unresolved contradictions: both sides kept, usage decides which was right.

status.description: Set by the drift detector. Requirements with no measurable footprint go in open_loops, not here.

params.description: Template inputs (field name, start/end events, window, etc.).

tolerance.description: How far past target before a week counts as a breach. 'Broken' = 2x tolerance.

speaker.description: Role label as it appears in the transcript, e.g. 'Billing clerk 2'.

question_id.description: Q-N of the question this quote answered, if any. Powers the lineage view.
